narr: The remnants of Ida produced instances of flooding and flash flooding across the area. Tropical moisture infiltrated the area and there were moderate amounts of instability as well. This combined with the lift provided from the remnants of Ida led to heavy rainfall during this time. Rainfall amounts averaged around 1-3.
ev: Broad Branch Drive Northwest was washed out between Davenport Street Northwest and Ridge Road Northwest. Trees and boulders were floating across where the roadway used to be.
lsr: BROAD BRANCH DRIVE NORTHWEST WASHED OUT BETWEEN DAVENPORT STREET NORTHWEST AND RIDGE ROAD NORTHWEST. TREES AND BOULDERS WERE FLOATING ACROSS WHERE THE ROADWAY USED TO BE.
